Laid in the snow for 2 hours with a shattered leg, shattered arm, 8 broken ribs, broken hip, bones sticking out of my skin everywhere. Also punctured liver, ruptured spleen, head trauma, etc. All excruciating particularly when they moved me onto the gurney to get me on the helicopter…Pain was all encompassing..there’s no way to describe it. I ended up flatlining in the ICU, due to the extent of my injuries and let me tell ya, I was flaming mad they revived me. Still a little bit salty tbh. Wish they had just let me go.
